```{ojs}
//| output: true
u1hViz = {
  const M = [
    {name: "Transit", color: "#38bdf8", how: "the planet dimmed its star's light as it passed in front"},
    {name: "Radial velocity", color: "#fbbf24", how: "the planet made its star wobble"},
    {name: "Microlensing", color: "#a3e635", how: "its star bent the light of a star behind it"},
    {name: "Direct imaging", color: "#f472b6", how: "a telescope photographed the planet itself"},
    {name: "Other", color: "#cbd5e1", how: "another method"}
  ];
  const planets = u1hRaw.map(([name, year, m, per, rad]) => ({name, year, m, per, rad}));
  const cumul = new Map();
  let run = 0;
  for (let y = 1992; y <= 2026; y++) { run += (u1hCounts.get(y) || 0); cumul.set(y, run); }
  const Y0 = 1992, Y1 = 2026;
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const fmt = d3.format(",");

  const wrap = html`<div class="u1h-viz"></div>`;
  const countNum = html`<span class="u1h-count-num">0</span>`;
  const countLabel = html`<span class="u1h-count-label"></span>`;
  const count = html`<div class="u1h-count" aria-hidden="true"></div>`;
  count.append(countNum, countLabel);
  const cwrap = html`<div class="u1h-canvas-wrap"></div>`;
  const canvas = html`<canvas role="img" aria-label="Scatter plot of about 6,000 confirmed exoplanets from the NASA Exoplanet Archive. The horizontal axis is how long each planet takes to orbit its star, from less than a day to thousands of years. The vertical axis is planet size compared to Earth. Most planets found so far orbit their stars in days to weeks and are bigger than Earth. Very few dots sit near Earth's spot: Earth-sized with a one-year orbit."></canvas>`;
  cwrap.append(canvas);
  const play = html`<button class="u1h-play" type="button" aria-label="Play the discoveries year by year">▶</button>`;
  const range = html`<input class="u1h-range" type="range" min=${Y0} max=${Y1} step="1" value=${reduceMotion ? Y1 : Y0} aria-label="Show planets discovered up to this year">`;
  const yearEl = html`<span class="u1h-year" aria-hidden="true"></span>`;
  const controls = html`<div class="u1h-controls"></div>`;
  controls.append(play, range, yearEl);
  const read = html`<p class="u1h-read" aria-live="polite"></p>`;
  const legend = html`<div class="u1h-legend" aria-hidden="true">${M.map(m => html`<span><i style="background:${m.color}"></i>${m.name}</span>`)}<span>◎ = Earth &amp; Jupiter</span></div>`;
  wrap.append(count, cwrap, controls, read, legend);

  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  let W = 600, H = 380, dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  let year = +range.value, selected = null;
  const m = {l: 44, r: 12, t: 10, b: 38};
  const x = d3.scaleLog().domain([0.15, 2e5]).clamp(true);
  const y = d3.scaleLog().domain([0.3, 30]).clamp(true);
  const xTicksWide = [[1, "1 day"], [10, "10 days"], [100, "100 days"], [365.25, "1 yr"], [3652.5, "10 yrs"], [36525, "100 yrs"]];
  const xTicksNarrow = [[1, "1 day"], [10, "10 days"], [365.25, "1 yr"], [36525, "100 yrs"]];
  let xTicks = xTicksWide;
  const yTicks = [[0.5, "½×"], [1, "1×"], [2, "2×"], [4, "4×"], [10, "10×"], [20, "20×"]];
  const ref = [{name: "Earth", per: 365.25, rad: 1}, {name: "Jupiter", per: 4332.6, rad: 11.2}];

  function size() {
    W = Math.max(300, cwrap.clientWidth);
    H = Math.round(Math.max(300, Math.min(440, W * 0.62)));
    canvas.width = W * dpr; canvas.height = H * dpr; canvas.style.height = H + "px";
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    x.range([m.l, W - m.r]); y.range([H - m.b, m.t]);
    xTicks = W < 560 ? xTicksNarrow : xTicksWide;
  }

  function draw(fresh = 0) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.font = "11px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(196,181,253,0.14)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#a5a1c9";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    for (const [v, t] of xTicks) { const px = x(v); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, m.t); ctx.lineTo(px, H - m.b); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillText(t, px, H - m.b + 5); }
    ctx.textAlign = "right"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    for (const [v, t] of yTicks) { const py = y(v); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(m.l, py); ctx.lineTo(W - m.r, py); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillText(t, m.l - 6, py); }
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ddd6fe"; ctx.font = "600 11.5px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
    ctx.fillText("How long one orbit takes (that planet's “year”) →", (m.l + W - m.r) / 2, H - 2);
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(11, (m.t + H - m.b) / 2); ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2); ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("Size compared to Earth →", 0, 0); ctx.restore();

    const r = W < 480 ? 1.6 : 2.1;
    for (const p of planets) {
      if (p.year > year) break;
      const isNew = p.year === year && fresh > 0;
      ctx.globalAlpha = isNew ? 1 : 0.62;
      ctx.fillStyle = M[p.m].color;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x(p.per), y(p.rad), isNew ? r + 1.6 * fresh : r, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    for (const s of ref) {
      const px = x(s.per), py = y(s.rad);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 6.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = s.name === "Earth" ? "#4ade80" : "#fdba74";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 3, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();
      ctx.font = "700 12px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,10,40,0.9)"; ctx.strokeText(s.name, px + 10, py);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.fillText(s.name, px + 10, py);
    }
    if (selected && selected.year <= year) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#fde68a"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x(selected.per), y(selected.rad), 7, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  const sizeWord = r => r < 0.8 ? "smaller than Earth" : r <= 1.25 ? "about Earth's size" : r < 2 ? "a bit bigger than Earth (a “super-Earth”)" : r < 6 ? "Neptune-like in size" : "a gas giant like Jupiter";
  const perWord = p => p < 1 ? `${Math.round(p * 24)} hours` : p < 730 ? `${d3.format(",.3~r")(p)} days` : `${d3.format(",.2~r")(p / 365.25)} Earth years`;
  function defaultRead() {
    read.innerHTML = year === Y1
      ? `Each dot is a real planet. <b>Tap or hover over a dot</b> to meet it, or press ▶ to watch the discoveries pile up.`
      : `<b>${year}:</b> ${fmt(u1hCounts.get(year) || 0)} new planet${(u1hCounts.get(year) || 0) === 1 ? "" : "s"} confirmed that year.`;
  }
  function setYear(v, fresh = 0) {
    year = v; range.value = v; yearEl.textContent = v;
    countNum.textContent = fmt(cumul.get(v));
    countLabel.textContent = v === Y1 ? "planets confirmed so far" : `planets known by the end of ${v}`;
    range.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", `${v}: ${fmt(cumul.get(v))} planets known`);
    if (!selected) defaultRead();
    draw(fresh);
  }

  // Tap / hover to identify the nearest planet
  function pick(e) {
    const b = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const px = e.clientX - b.left, py = e.clientY - b.top;
    let best = null, bd = 14;
    for (const p of planets) {
      if (p.year > year) break;
      const d = Math.hypot(x(p.per) - px, y(p.rad) - py);
      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = p; }
    }
    for (const s of ref) if (Math.hypot(x(s.per) - px, y(s.rad) - py) < 10) { best = {...s, ref: true}; }
    selected = best && !best.ref ? best : null;
    if (best && best.ref) read.innerHTML = best.name === "Earth"
      ? `<b>Earth</b>: 1× Earth's size, orbits in 365 days. Look how few dots sit near it. Small planets with long orbits are the <b>hardest to find</b>.`
      : `<b>Jupiter</b>: about 11× Earth's size, orbits in about 12 Earth years. Our own solar system, for comparison.`;
    else if (best) read.innerHTML = `<b>${best.name}</b> · ${sizeWord(best.rad)} (${best.rad}× Earth${best.m === 1 ? ", estimated from its mass" : ""}) · orbits in ${perWord(best.per)} · found in ${best.year}: ${M[best.m].how}.`;
    else defaultRead();
    draw();
  }
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", pick);
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", e => { if (e.pointerType === "mouse") pick(e); });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerleave", e => { if (e.pointerType === "mouse") { selected = null; defaultRead(); draw(); } });

  // Play: one year at a time, with fresh discoveries popping in
  let timer = null, visible = false, autoplayed = false;
  const stop = () => { if (timer) { timer.stop(); timer = null; } play.textContent = "▶"; play.setAttribute("aria-label", "Play the discoveries year by year"); };
  const start = () => {
    if (!visible) return;
    if (year >= Y1) setYear(Y0);
    selected = null;
    play.textContent = "❚❚"; play.setAttribute("aria-label", "Pause");
    let t0 = null;
    const step = reduceMotion ? 1 : 520;
    timer = d3.timer(el => {
      if (t0 === null) t0 = el;
      const k = (el - t0) / step;
      if (k >= 1) {
        t0 = el;
        if (year >= Y1) { stop(); setYear(Y1); return; }
        setYear(year + 1, 1);
      } else if (!reduceMotion) draw(1 - k);
    });
  };
  play.addEventListener("click", () => timer ? stop() : start());
  range.addEventListener("input", () => { stop(); selected = null; setYear(+range.value); });

  const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => { size(); draw(); });
  ro.observe(cwrap);
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => {
    visible = e.isIntersecting;
    if (!visible) stop();
    else if (!autoplayed && !reduceMotion) { autoplayed = true; start(); }
  });
  io.observe(canvas);
  invalidation.then(() => { stop(); ro.disconnect(); io.disconnect(); });

  size();
  setYear(+range.value);
  return wrap;
}
```

```{=html}
  <p class="u1h-source">Data: <a href="https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">NASA Exoplanet Archive</a>, Planetary Systems Composite table, downloaded November 2026 (6,464 confirmed planets, 1992–2026; the 6,063 with a known size and orbit are plotted). 2026 is a partial year. Many planets found by the wobble method have no measured size, so the archive estimates it from their mass; that's why so many line up near 12–14× Earth. Earth and Jupiter are shown for comparison.</p>
</section>
```

## Anchor Phenomenon

> **Out of all of the planets in the solar system, only Earth has life! Earth didn't have life for a long time, and now it does. What makes Earth so special?**

## Unit Driving Question

> **What has made Earth able to sustain life? If we can't stop the negative changes to our planet, is there an exoplanet Earth-like enough to sustain life?**

## Unit Overview

Earth has been an ideal place for humans and other life to thrive for 12,000 years. But rising global temperatures are causing sea levels to rise, floods and droughts to increase, and species to disappear in what scientists call the "Sixth Mass Extinction." In this unit, you investigate what makes Earth uniquely habitable — from our Sun's energy output to our planet's orbit — and then use that knowledge to evaluate real exoplanet data and argue which distant world might be able to support life.

## What You'll Figure Out

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

- ☀️ **Model** how the Sun produces energy through nuclear fusion and predict its future stages
- 🔭 **Analyze** light spectra to determine the composition of stars
- ⭐ **Explain** why some stars are stable for billions of years while others explode
- 🪐 **Use** Kepler's Laws to calculate and predict planetary orbits
- 🌡️ **Determine** whether an exoplanet stays within its star's habitable zone
- 📢 **Construct** an evidence-based argument about which exoplanet is most likely habitable
